notes: Sheet is drawn rotated (E. 3rd runs left-right across the middle). E. 3RD (50') enters at the west edge on the upper level, with MARTIN (lower level, labelled at the west edge) separated from it by the STONE RETAINING WALL 1 TO 40' HIGH; the wall ends at x~1500 and the two merge into one 50 ft street (house numbers 1012-1026 and 1101-1139 printed E. 3RD) just west of Parsons. The merge point (1580,2000) is a Y, placed about 80 px east of the wall tip; it is only good to about +-30 px. Martin leaves 3rd again to the NE at the 1004-1006 MARTIN lots; the Martin/3rd fork point (2405,2012) is where Martin's diagonal centreline (offset 20 ft from its SE face, which starts at the gore at x~2655, y~1905) meets 3rd's centreline. HILL (50', straight, ESE) enters at the west edge (centre y~894) and ends at Martin (T at 2815,1688, where Hill's pipe meets Martin's). PARSONS (33', faces ~117 px apart, straight, leaning SSW) runs from 3rd to E. Front. WHITTAKER (50'; printed WITTAKER at 3rd and WHITTAKER further south) runs from 3rd to E. Front; 3rd's north face stops at x~3219 and nothing is drawn north or east of the Whittaker/3rd junction (blank, other sheets), so it is recorded as T. E. FRONT (40' printed at Parsons and Whittaker; north face y~3025-3038, first track ~y 3155) runs along the bottom. Top of sheet: FORT VIEW PL. (PAVILION) (printed so; 'PAVILION' also printed small on a paste-over) runs ESE between the 129/130 blocks and block 1, from about 20 ft wide at the west to 40' at the east end, then bends ENE. CARNEY comes down from sheet 129 (where it is printed CARNEY (FORT VIEW PL.)) between the two 129 blocks (about 44 ft) and ends at Fort View Pl.; name taken from sheet 129. West of Carney the narrow strip continuing WNW to the top edge is the Pavilion of sheet 128 (not separately recorded, no crossing on this sheet other than the not-opened alley). PERPENDICULAR ALLEY crosses Hill at x~640: south of Hill it is printed PERPENDICULAR ALLEY with WOOD STEPS (15') down to 3rd; north of Hill an unlabelled strip continues NNE to Fort View Pl. (sheet 128 calls it not opened); both parts are listed under alleys, not as intersections. A strip of WOOD STEPS (unnamed) runs from the Fort View Pl. bend at x~2700-2760 down to Martin beside the Hill junction (stairway, not recorded as a street). An unnamed 10' alley runs ESE between Hill and Fort View Pl. from the not-opened Perpendicular Alley to the wood steps. A 15' alley runs from Whittaker into block 4 and dead-ends. Paste-overs (wagon shed, club room) sit across the south half of Fort View Pl.'s strip between x~1650 and 2450. Railroad tracks and the river ignored.
